  -audit-catalog string
    	exact catalog to audit privately
  -audit-out string
    	explicit native audit output
  -candidate string
    	exact native candidate input
  -candidate-out string
    	generate source-bound candidate without approvals
  -check
    	rebuild unchanged baseline and check exact approved bytes
  -expected-sha256 string
    	explicit reviewed output artifact pin for installation
  -factual-review string
    	complete factual review
  -final-factual-review string
    	final factual acceptance
  -final-quality-review string
    	final quality acceptance
  -installed-authority-out string
    	build draft installed-authority entry from current independently reviewed installed artifact; never write manifest or pin
  -live-audit string
    	bound saved native audit
  -proposal string
    	explicit saved proposal output
  -quality-review string
    	complete independent quality review
  -root string
    	repository root (default "..")
  -source string
    	native authored JSON; changed source needs version>1 and exact parent_source_sha256
  -write
    	install only after bound native audit and final independent judgments
